blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 15671 of the Elections Code is amended to read:

In case of a tie vote for member of a county central committee, if the office is to be voted for wholly within one county, the election board shall forthwith summon the candidates who have received tie votes to appear before it, at a time and place to be designated by the board, and the board shall at that time and place determine the tie by lot.
digest: Under existing law, if a tie vote occurs in an election for member of a county central committee, and if the office is to be voted for wholly within one county, the election board shall summon the candidates who received tie votes to appear before the board, and the board shall determine the tie by lot.
This bill would make a nonsubstantive change to the above provision.
label: Introduced
subject: County central committee elections: tie votes.
title: An act to amend Section 15671 of the Elections Code, relating to elections.
